regime.skew: 25d call-rich (-0.89) over a put-rich tail: 13.59% on the 970 put and 14.33% on the 960 wing against 12.08% on the 1,110 call
regime.label: Dealer gamma neutral at the board (-1,338.4) but long at the money (+835.9 inside 20 points, per-strike flip pulled down to 1,040) while the window's largest OI build, +2,089 to 22,240, loads downside insurance over a short-gamma corridor at 1,020/1,000
evidence: +835.9 of net GEX inside 20 points of the money, up from +547.4 yesterday, and the per-strike flip has pulled down to 1,040 (+97.0) from 1,050 (+933.0), so spot 1,044.6 now sits on the long-gamma shelf rather than under it - dealer hedging inside 1,040-1,060 fades moves. Board-wide the sum is still -1,338.4 and cumulative net GEX is negative at every listed strike, deepest at spot (-6,391.3, below yesterday's -6,313.8), with the trough sliding to 1,030 from 1,040.

-1,329.1 at 1,020 and -1,451.2 at 1,000 are the two largest short-gamma strikes on the board and sit directly under the shelf: a close below the 1,040 flip hands dealers an amplifying hedge into the live 1,000 put zone. That corridor, not today's +1.3-point close, is the forced-flow risk.

+2,089 to 22,240 total OI is the largest one-day build of the eight-session window (18,666 on 10-16) and arrived on 4,271 lots, also the window high - flow is entering, not unwinding, which rules out the Unwind read. Put OI 11,380 against call OI 10,860 lifts pc_oi to 1.048, the window high, while pc_vol 0.88 says today's tape was call-led.

2,014 contracts at the 960 put wall traded 156 lots and built +109 OI at 14.33% IV, 2.72 points over the 11.61% ATM - genuine tail insurance 84.6 points (8.1%) away, the Protection signature. The live near-money levels pass Vol2Vol on their own terms: 1,050 calls (1,439 OI, +220, 377 lots) and 1,020 puts (1,145 OI, +229, 390 lots, the board's heaviest volume).

S50Z26.today_summary: 1,044.6 on the December future is +1.3 points (+0.12%), a stabilisation after yesterday's -11.6, and still 5.4 points below a 1,050 max pain that has now held 11 consecutive sessions. Net board GEX repaired to -1,338.4 from -1,653.0 and the ATM-zone sum rebuilt to +835.9 from +547.4, with the per-strike gamma flip pulling down to 1,040 so that spot sits on the long-gamma shelf (1,040 +97.0, 1,050 +933.0) instead of beneath it; cumulative GEX stays negative at every strike and is deepest at spot, -6,391.3. ATM IV compressed 0.56 to 11.61% off the 12.17% window high, trimming the implied 1-sigma day to 7.64 points (0.73%). Total OI built +2,089 to 22,240 on 4,271 lots - both window highs - with the build concentrated at 1,040C (+239), 1,020P (+229), 1,050C (+220), 1,030P (+157) and 1,050P (+156).
what_changed: Net board GEX repaired to -1,338.4 from -1,653.0 and ATM-zone GEX to +835.9 from +547.4, with the per-strike flip pulling down to 1,040 from 1,050 - spot 1,044.6 is back on the long-gamma shelf, though no strike on the 960-1,150 ladder carries a positive cumulative sum yet.

Total OI built +2,089 to 22,240, the window's largest one-day build, on 4,271 lots, the window's heaviest volume; pc_oi 1.048 is a window high and the 960 put wall added +109 on 156 lots at 14.33% IV.
ATM IV compressed 0.56 to 11.61% from the 12.17% window high, cutting the implied 1-sigma day to 7.64 points from 7.99.
Spot recovered +1.3 to 1,044.6 but stayed 5.4 points under the unchanged 1,050 max pain, and cumulative GEX at spot deepened to -6,391.3 with its trough sliding to 1,030 from 1,040.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: Max pain has sat at 1,050 for all 11 sessions on file and the structural walls have not moved - 1,100 calls (1,478 OI) and 960 puts (2,014 OI) - so the only migration of the window is the near call wall dropping 1,100 to 1,050 on 10-21 and staying there, pulling the active range down with spot. The dealer-gamma sequence is the headline: +797.9 board GEX on 10-16, +174.5 on 10-20, -1,653.0 on 10-21 and -1,338.4 today, one sign flip that has not been undone, with the in-chain gamma flip lost entirely (1,110 on 10-16, 1,150 on 10-20, none since). IV has round-tripped 10.73% (10-20) to 12.17% (10-21) to 11.61%, so the 11.6% level is the window median, not a compression extreme, and the 1-sigma day is back to 7.64 points. The decisive five-day difference is OI, not price: 18,666 on 10-16 against 22,240 today, +19% in four sessions and +2,089 today alone, which is a Protection build rather than the Unwind that would mark the short-gamma phase fading. Price is 8.8 points below the 1,055.4 high of 10-20 while dealers have gone from fading moves to amplifying them below 1,040 - the structure, not the tape, has done the moving.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1,030 / 1,000
strategies.rationale: 68 days of Protection-zone insurance demand plus the -1,329.1 / -1,451.2 short-gamma corridor at 1,020 / 1,000 means a loss of the 1,040 flip gets hedged with the move, and the long strike sits on the 1,030 put build (+157 OI, 224 lots) while the short strike rests on the live 1,000 wall (1,282 OI, 174 lots, the 25d put).
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 8.8-point debit (1,030 put 15.9 ask less 1,000 put 7.1 bid); maximum value 30 points at or below 1,000, so 21.2 points of payoff against 8.8 at risk.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1,050 max pain, which restores the +933.0 long-gamma shelf and leaves the structure paying time decay.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1,000P / 980P x 1,080C / 1,100C
strategies.rationale: The +835.9 ATM-gamma shelf fades moves inside 1,040-1,060 and both short strikes sit outside the live walls and the 25d band (1,000 put / 1,070 call), with the 1,080 (1,180 OI) and 1,100 (1,478 OI) call stack capping upside drift at 11.61% ATM IV.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point wing width less 5.5-point net credit = 14.5 points on whichever side is breached (credit from 1,000P 7.1 + 1,080C 7.4 bids less 980P 4.9 + 1,100C 4.1 asks).
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1,000 or above 1,080 on expanding volume; note the 1-sigma move to the 12-29 expiry is 62.9 points (982-1,108), so both short strikes sit inside that band and the structure is only defensible actively managed, not carried to settlement.

S50Z26.prediction: 1,044.6 holding the 1,040 per-strike gamma flip keeps the base case a fade back toward the 1,050 max pain that has anchored 11 sessions, with a 7.64-point 1-sigma day framing a 1,037-1,052 one-day envelope. The invalidation is specific: a close below 1,040 opens the -1,329.1 / -1,451.2 short-gamma corridor toward the live 1,000 put wall, while a close above the 1,070 25d call on expanding call volume ends the fade and puts the 1,080/1,100 call stack in play. Board GEX staying negative at -1,338.4 means the downside break is the higher-energy path of the two.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no instruction to execute anything. Defined risk is not risk-free: the 8.8-point debit and the 14.5-point condor loss are real and fully realisable. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks - treat the 1,050 max pain and the 1,040-1,060 gamma shelf as tendencies, not guarantees. With 68 days to the 12-29 expiry, gamma is diffuse and macro or news flow can overrun the option structure outright, as the -11.6-point 10-21 session did.
